one_sentence_story: By comparing brain proportions across 38 primate groups in 1992, Robin Dunbar discovered neocortex size scales with troop size — predicting that human brains and daily clocks can actively maintain roughly 150 real, two-way relationships (and just ~5 intimate lifelines).
so_what_for_you: Stop mistaking 2,000 online followers for a support network: guard real face-to-face hours for your inner 5 and 15 circles, and split growing organizations into human-sized <150 units.
